text: You cannot have your cake and eat it, too.
zh: 既要馬好，又要馬不吃草。
author: CK

text: You need to have friends who can help you out.
zh: 你需要可以幫助你的朋友。
author: CK

text: This school supplies students with textbooks.
zh: 這所學校為學生提供教科書。
author: CK

text: I'm sure Tom will happy to do that for Mary.
author: CK

text: Did you remember your father's birthday?
zh: 你記得了你父親的生日嗎？
author: CK
